Tam Velo Club Sunday Recovery Ride

Mill Valley, CA · Road

No-drop

Tam Velo Club Sunday Recovery Ride is a road group ride in Mill Valley, CA. It rolls every Sunday at 9:35 am from Equator Coffees at Proof Lab. About 25–35 miles, moderate, 14–17 mph average, no-drop with regroups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:35 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @tamveloclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tam Velo Club Sunday Recovery Ride group ride

Marin's community cycling club runs a shorter Sunday ride from Equator Coffees in Mill Valley. Moderate pace, 25 to 35 miles, with set regroup points. Not a beginner pace, but no one is dropped. A longer, faster ride leaves from the same spot on Saturdays at 8:30 am.
